readme:
## Package overview

This package provides functions for doing vector operations including calculating the `L1` and `L2` norm, dot product, cosine similarity, Euclidean distance, and Manhattan distance.

## Report issues

To report bugs, request new features, start new discussions, view project boards, etc., go to the [Ballerina standard library parent repository](https://github.com/ballerina-platform/ballerina-standard-library).

### Useful links

- Chat live with us via our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/ballerinalang).
- Post all technical questions on Stack Overflow with the [#ballerina](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/ballerina) tag.

typeDefs.name: NormType
typeDefs.description:
An enum containing the supported norm types.
L1 - L1 norm which is the sum of the absolute values of the vector elements
L2 - L2 norm which is the square root of the sum of the squared vector elements.

functions.name: vectorNorm
functions.description:
Calculates the L1 and L2 norm of a float vector.

```ballerina
float[] v = [1.0, 2.0, 3.0];
vectorNorm(v, vector:L2) ⇒ 3.7416573867739413
vectorNorm(v, vector:L1) ⇒ 6.0
```

parameters.name: norm
parameters.description: norm type to calculate out of [L1, L2]

return.description: the L1 or L2 norm of the given float vector

functions.name: dotProduct

return.description: the dot product of the given two vectors

functions.name: cosineSimilarity

return.description: the cosine similarity between the given two vectors

functions.name: euclideanDistance

return.description: the Euclidean distance between the given two vectors

functions.name: manhattanDistance

return.description: the Manhattan distance between the given two vectors
